history.summary: A tiny 24-unit freehold boutique in Telok Kurau (TOP 2025) reselling at $2,513 psf / $3.3M — versus a 2022 launch price of ~$1,953 psf for 4BR. The markup is steep, liquidity is minimal (24 units), and new-launch bias inflates the data; this is an Avoid for investment.
history.rating_rationale: Baywind launched in 2022 at ~$1,953 psf for 4BR; the current $2,513 psf ask is ~6% above the $2,378 URA median and a heavy premium to its own launch basis on a flagged new-launch-bias series of only 26 txns. A 24-unit boutique offers very shallow resale liquidity, the $3.3M quantum sits well outside the liquid band, and the 730m walk to Marine Terrace MRT is the only modest catalyst. Score_1000 392 confirms a sub-market profile.
